answer.short: Black hair only: $5$; both: $11$; brown eyes only: $6$; neither: $8$.
answer.worked:
The Brown eyes/Black hair cell gives both, $11$. The Not brown eyes/Black hair cell gives black hair only, $5$. The Brown eyes/Not black hair cell gives brown eyes only, $6$. The Not brown eyes/Not black hair cell gives neither, $8$.
$$5+11+6+8=30$$
